create_PandaPickCubeCartesian: create a PandaPickCubeCartesian environment for training a Franka Panda robot to pick up a cube in Cartesian space
run_PandaPickCubeCartesian_step: run the step method of PandaPickCubeCartesian to advance the environment by one timestep with a given action
run_PandaPickCubeCartesian_reset: run the reset method of PandaPickCubeCartesian to initialize the environment with a random box position and fixed target
build_default_config: build a default configuration for the PandaPickCubeCartesian environment with reward scales and vision settings
use_adjust_brightness: use the adjust_brightness function to scale pixel values of an image for brightness augmentation
